emails.subject: Quick question on technical recruiting workflow
emails.body:
Hi Stephanie,

I am building Hirelix for technical recruiters who work on software, data, DevOps, and security roles.

Averity's specialized teams around software engineering, data engineering, data science, DevOps, and security looked very relevant. Hirelix focuses on one narrow workflow: client JD in, evidence-backed technical shortlist out.

It ranks real profiles with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach context a recruiter can personalize before contacting candidates.

Would you be open to a quick look and blunt feedback on whether this would save review time for a technical recruiting desk?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online
